chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
If a believer enrages his brother, it means that he leaves him.

key_terms.فَارَقَهُ: he separated from him / left him

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when a believer enrages his brother according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) states that if a believer becomes angry with his brother in faith, it signifies a separation or estrangement between them. This teaching highlights the fragility of spiritual bonds when anger takes hold, reflecting the Shia emphasis on *mawaddah* (affection) as a core component of faith. The phrase 'hashtama' implies a deep, visceral anger that disrupts the spiritual connection, urging believers to prioritize reconciliation over ego.

en.sayed-ali-raza: 480. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said:
If a believer enrages (iḥtashama) his brother, it means that he leaves him.
